emma_finance: FYI AcmeHealth flagged invoice 69011 (private). It shows an overage + a PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ credit and procurement wants an explanation.

raj_sales: Which invoice lines?

emma_finance: Invoice excerpt: Private license $120,000; Platform fee $30,000; Support prorate $4,500; Usage overage $7,200; PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ -$6,000. Net unexpected +$1,200.

marta_revops: Ops evidence: dedicated pool scaled to 118% for ~3h during their bulk import (ops-bot event). Sales apparently approved a verbal concession but no formal credit memo posted.

ops-bot: Event: scaling spike 2025-10-03T02:15Z, peak 118%, duration 3h15m, job-id=import-acme-20251003.

support_agent: Customer wrote: "We were billed for a spike caused during Redwood onboarding. Please reverse or explain."

emma_finance: I'm wary of full reversal precedent. Suggest a partial concession: 70% credit of the $7,200 overage = $5,040, contingent on a signed PO addendum acknowledging shared responsibility.

raj_sales: I can get the PO addendum signed (ask Acme to acknowledge import was part of onboarding and accept partial responsibility). ETA 48h. Sales agrees to 70% if signed.

lex_billing: Once PO addendum + RevOps logs/support thread are attached to Zendesk FIN-xxxx, billing will post credit memo $5,040, GL 4202, memo "Onboarding migration overage concession, 70% approved", and link it to invoice 69011. Will hold until artifacts are present.

marta_revops: I'll attach ops logs and support transcript to the ticket and include internal approval notes.

emma_finance: Approved conditional on PO addendum + attachments. Finance will sign off to issue credit memo once docs are in place.

(End of thread)
